source: Overpass API attic (historical) queries against OpenStreetMap
licence: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap contributors) - share-alike; anything published from these files keeps the ODbL label
purpose: Measure the pre-light-rail Hunter Street / Scott Street cross-section as OSM recorded it before construction started (~Sep 2017), for A.corridor.pre_lr_lanes_per_dir (hypothesis B3's counterfactual; DECISIONS.md 9.71).

overpass_attic_hunter_scott_2017-01-01.j.note: pre-construction state; 22 ways, 21 named street segments after excluding one service alley

overpass_attic_hunter_scott_2016-01-01.j.note: cross-check one year earlier; fully consistent with the 2017 state

finding: Every lane-tagged segment (9 of 21 in 2017, 43% coverage) carried lanes=2 with oneway=no - one lane per direction; zero segments tagged 4 lanes or lanes:forward/backward at either date. The only oneway elements are the pedestrianised Hunter Street Mall pair (living_street).
caveats: OSM lanes tags record marked through-lanes as mappers saw them; 57% of segments carry no lane tag and are silent, not contradictory. The bounding box is the query's own search window over central Newcastle, recorded here as provenance, not a modelling extent.
endpoint_behaviour: overpass-api.de rate-limits back-to-back attic queries (Dispatcher_Client rate_limited); the kumi.systems mirror does not serve attic data (Internal Server Error).
